cohort: The study included all women who underwent singleton vaginal delivery in a tertiary hospital in Assir region between January 2014 and December 2019.
finding: The incidence of third- and fourth-degree perineal tears was 0.43% of all vaginal deliveries, with episiotomy, occipitoposterior presentation, primigravida, multipara, and a previous episiotomy identified as significant predisposing factors.
